title: Check out 3711 McCleland in Temple, TX!
description:
Welcome to 3711 McCleland Creek Trail in Temple, Texas! Check out this beautiful home located in the highly sought-after Prairie Ridge community. Built in 2022, this well-maintained home offers a modern layout, comfortable living spaces, and a location that makes everyday life easy.

With 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,400 square feet, this home is perfect for buyers looking for something newer, low-maintenance, and move-in ready.

🏡 PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
The Layout: Functional open floor plan designed for comfortable everyday living and easy entertaining.
The Living Space: Bright and welcoming with abundant natural light throughout the main areas.
The Kitchen: Open to the living room, making it the heart of the home and perfect for gathering.
The Bedrooms: 3 spacious bedrooms including a private primary suite retreat.
The Home: Built in 2022 with modern finishes and thoughtful design.

📍 LOCATION:
Located in Temple, TX (76502) in the Prairie Ridge community. You’re close to shopping, dining, schools, and major highways, making commuting and daily errands quick and convenient.
